### ⛲ Fountains and hedges
- Three fountains for your maps — a small basin, a plaza fountain and a grand tiered one — with real running water, spray and ripples in the bowl.
- Seven clipped hedges: straight, tall, low, overgrown, a corner piece, and topiary balls and cones. They wear the same leaves as the bushes out in the world.
- Eight more school fittings to dress an interior with: radiators, a canteen serving counter and tables, a coat rack row, a fire extinguisher, a hydrant cabinet, a trophy case and a drinking fountain.

### 🎨 Map editor
- Every colour field now has one-click swatches, grouped by material — neutrals, stone, wood, metal, nature and accents — instead of hunting for a shade in the picker.
- The prop picker is a category column beside the list, so 136 props are something you navigate rather than scroll past.
- It also opens where you left it: same category, same search, same prop selected. Placing six desks no longer means finding the school category six times.
- Maps and buildings are credited to your profile nickname, so renaming yourself renames everything you have ever published.
- **Your library is yours.** Browse in the map editor and the structure library now list what you made, instead of everything anybody ever published. Other people's maps are all still there to play, and their buildings are all still in the palette to place — what changed is only what the editor offers you to open and re-author.

### 🌍 Site and account
- The website is properly bilingual: English at shveeskay.com, Czech at /cs, each a real page you can link and share. Before, both languages lived at one address and only one of them could ever be found by a search engine.
- The e-mails the game sends — confirm your account, reset your password, sign-in links — now look like the game instead of like a default form letter.
